hooks.text: A Texas City dock fire destroyed an entire municipal fire department.
A standard shipboard fire wiped out an entire city's firefighting force.
One dock blast in Texas City destroyed every municipal fire truck.

title: What Erased Texas City's Fire Department in Seconds? ⚠️
description: In 1947, the Texas City disaster unfolded when the freighter SS Grandcamp exploded with catastrophic force. A second ship detonated hours later, devastating the port.
